title: Slow cooling and the geomagnetic polarity history link protracted thermoviscous remagnetization to superchrons
description: Code and derived data for Pescarini et al., submitted to Geophysical Journal International. The scripts model thermoviscous resetting and continuous-cooling blocking of single-domain pyrrhotite and magnetite, and the vector cancellation of the acquired moment under a stochastic geomagnetic polarity history. The remagnetized carbonates of the Nama Group (Namibia) are the case study; the TROUT unmixing of the demagnetization data and the Raman thermometry that constrain the model are included. The workflow also includes specimen selection, RSCM band fitting and a reversal-coherence filter. The scripts reproduce Figs 1 and 3–7 and Tables S1–S7.
